p: An all-you-can-eat establishment focusing on grilled clams and shellfish (jogae gui).
Specializes in jangeo maeuntang (spicy eel stew). The dish is served in a communal pot, combining fresh eel, vegetables, and spicy seasoning. It is a typical local favorite in the coastal region.
The primary dish is jangeo cheopbap (grilled eel on rice), often prepared in a Japanese style with a sweet glaze. It is considered a specialty meal in the area.
Focuses on galbi jjim (braised short ribs), a traditional slow-cooked beef or pork dish. The meat is braised in a soy sauce-based marinade with vegetables and served in a hot pot.
A modern pub that features a rotating selection of local and imported craft beers on tap. They also offer simple food items (anju) designed to accompany beer.
